text: The surface of distant planets, such as Mars, is characterized by numerous craters that have been formed through asteroid or comet impacts. These craters can be so large that they are observable from Earth, and the features of the planets, including Mars, are visible in the form of these craters. The Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter has provided images of the largest known crater on Mars, which is the 3,200-kilometer-wide Hellas Planum.
